name: GAP SCALP
description: Sub-strategy of v8.0 for gap stocks at market open. Enter at 15:30:00, sell into first spike within 3-5 min, never hold past 5 min.
applies_when: First 5 minutes after market open (15:30-15:35 Oslo) on stocks gapping >20% from pre-market scan

entry.what: Market order on ALL pre-market targets gapping >20%
entry.sizing: FLOOR($10 / $1.00) — use $1.00 fixed stop for gap scalps

exit.primary: Sell into first spike — when price makes first new high then starts pulling back, SELL immediately
exit.time_exit: If no spike within 3 minutes, close at market. MAX hold 5 minutes.
exit.target: NO fixed TP — sell into strength. Take whatever the spike gives (+$2 to +$10 per share typical)
exit.never: NEVER hold a gap scalp past 5 minutes. The move is OVER.

after_5_min: Switch to normal v8.0 rules (EMA 8 entries, $20 TP) for the rest of the session

cron_implementation.15:30:00: SNIPER — place market orders on all pre-market gap targets
cron_implementation.15:33:00: CHECK — any position in profit? Sell into strength. Any making new high? Hold 1 more min.
cron_implementation.15:35:00: CLOSE ALL gap scalp positions regardless of P&L. Gap scalp window is OVER.
cron_implementation.15:35+: Switch to normal v8.0/v8.1/v8.2/v8.3 evaluation for rest of session

ross_cameron_rules.2: Enter break of pre-market high OR at market open
ross_cameron_rules.3: Sell into first spike — NEVER hold hoping for more
ross_cameron_rules.4: Max 30 min hold (we use 5 min for scalp mode)
ross_cameron_rules.5: If no break within 5 min, skip — momentum is dead

note: GAP SCALP is a TIMING mode, not a strategy. ALL 4 strategies use it at market open. Each strategy applies its own stop/target rules within the 5-min window.

per_strategy_differences.v8.0: Stop $1.00 below open. Sell into spike. Tag GAP_SCALP in journal-v80.json
per_strategy_differences.v8.1: Stop 1 ATR below open. Sell into spike OR hold if buildup forming. Tag GAP_SCALP in journal-v81.json
per_strategy_differences.v8.2: Only crypto gaps. Check BTC vs 21w EMA first. Tighter stop if counter-trend. Tag GAP_SCALP in journal-v82.json
per_strategy_differences.v8.3: Only forex gaps at London open (09:00 Oslo). Liquidity sweep check. Tag GAP_SCALP in journal-v83.json
